basis: Hair loss defines this broad hair disorder; autoimmune mechanisms apply only to some subtypes.
Defining renal, adrenal and lung dysgenesis; cardiac malformations occur in 30–79%. GI clefts (2/3) and bowel malrotation omitted because of cap.
Inherited cataract affects the ocular lens and visual acuity.
Uterine cervix neoplasms arise in a reproductive organ outside the available axes.
Autonomic nerve dysfunction causes gustatory sweating; sweating and flushing do not establish skin damage.
Neurodegeneration with characteristic erythrocyte acanthocytosis; myopathy and muscle-fiber atrophy occur in 30–79%. Oral self-injury is secondary to dyskinesia.
Intellectual disability, primary hypogonadism and ichthyosis define the syndrome; strabismus affects ocular alignment in 80–99%.
Immune-mediated orbital/lacrimal disease; salivary inflammation occurs in 30–79%. Nerve enlargement lacks common functional damage; mononeuropathy is only 5–29%.
Disease directly involves the vagus nerve; dysfunction of its target organs is not established across this umbrella.
Bardet-Biedl and Joubert subtypes share substantial neurodevelopmental involvement; renal, retinal and endocrine involvement is not established across this umbrella.
Defined by skeletal muscle dystrophy and weakness. Cardiac conduction abnormality occurs in only 1/14; hyporeflexia alone does not establish neuropathy.
Combined immunodeficiency with defining T-cell dysfunction and lymphopenia in 5/5; B-cell and NK-cell depletion each occur in 3/5.
Isolated familial dilated cardiomyopathy directly affects myocardium; BAG3 alone does not establish skeletal myopathy.
Benign neoplasms originate in liver or biliary tissue; the digestive-system ancestor does not add gastrointestinal involvement.
Hemoglobinopathy causing absent or mild hemolytic anemia; splenic involvement remains within the haematologic axis.
Intellectual disability and developmental delay define the disorder; ventricular septal defect occurs in 2/5 (40%). Minor digital dysmorphism does not establish functional damage.
Hormone-secreting pituitary adenoma defines the disease. Acral overgrowth alone does not establish skeletal injury; cardiac damage frequency is unspecified.
Neoplasms arise from or directly occupy central or peripheral autonomic nervous tissue.
Developmental disability, fifth-nail hypoplasia and digital skeletal anomalies define the phenotype; hearing impairment affects 4/8 (50%). Constipation alone lacks evidence of injury.
Acrofacial dysostosis with preaxial and postaxial congenital skeletal defects; no other organ involvement is established.
Postinfectious inflammation of the cerebellum defines an immune-mediated neurologic disease.
Familial nephrotic syndrome with diffuse mesangial sclerosis directly damages renal glomeruli; an immune mechanism is not established.
Carcinoma originates in breast tissue, which has no available axis.
Metaphyseal chondrodysplasia defines skeletal disease; an unspecified metabolism/homeostasis annotation does not establish a metabolic disorder.
Familial vesicoureteral reflux affects the urinary tract; infection is a possible separate complication rather than an intrinsic mechanism.
